subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Predict what an email is about from the picture.
Decide if sentences about Razan's email are true or false.
Choose the best summary of a story and say why.

tf.s: Razan first went to the shoe shop with her friend Rasha.
Razan bought the shoes on the first day.
tf.why: She didn't buy them because she didn't have enough money.

tf.s: Razan didn't have enough money for the shoes.
tf.why: That is why she didn't buy them.

tf.s: Razan's friend Rasha bought the shoes.
The next week, Razan was sad because the shop assistant sold the shoes.
tf.why: The shoes were not in the shop any more.

tf.s: Rasha told Razan's mum that Razan wanted the shoes.
A good summary mentions all the important points.
tf.why: A summary tells the main points of the story.

tf.s: A good summary tells only the first sentence of the story.

tf.s: The text is a letter in a newspaper.
A shop assistant is a person who works in a shop.
tf.why: Shop assistants help customers in a shop.

boxes.q: Who did Razan first go to the shoe shop with?
Why didn't Razan buy the shoes?
Who bought the shoes in the end?
Where did Razan see the shoes?
boxes.why: She went to the shoe shop with Rasha.

boxes.q: What type of text is it?
Who works in a shop and helps customers?
boxes.why: A shop assistant works in a shop.

boxes.q: You put shoes on to see if they are right. You ______ them.
boxes.why: We try on shoes before we buy them.

boxes.q: The shoes are the right size. They ______.
boxes.why: Shoes that fit are the right size.

boxes.q: Which word means "nice to look at"?
boxes.why: Pretty means nice to look at.

boxes.q: What does a good summary do?
o: It mentions all the important points.
It tells only one small detail.
It is longer than the story.
boxes.why: A summary gives all the main points.

hunt.q: Put shoes on to check them

mcq.q: Why was Razan sad the next week?
o: The shop assistant sold the shoes.

mcq.q: Which words are in this lesson?
o: notice, shop assistant, pretty, fit, try on

mcq.why: When you notice something, you see it.

mcq.q: Correct the sentence: Her friend Rasha bought the shoes.
o: Razan bought the shoes on the first day.
mcq.why: Mum bought the shoes in the end.

mcq.q: You like some shoes in a shop. What do you do first?
o: Try them on to see if they fit.
mcq.why: We try on shoes to check they fit.

mcq.q: Which sentence is the best summary of the story?
o: Razan liked some shoes but didn't have enough money. Rasha told Mum, and Mum bought them for her.
mcq.why: It mentions all the important points.

mcq.q: Why is one summary better than another?
o: It mentions all the important points of the story.
It is shorter than one line.
mcq.why: Good summaries include all the main points.

mcq.q: How did Mum know that Razan wanted the shoes?
o: Mum saw Razan in the shop.
mcq.why: Rasha told Mum about the shoes.

mcq.q: What does the story show about Rasha?
o: She is a good friend who helps Razan.
She wants the shoes for herself.
She works in the shoe shop.
mcq.why: Rasha helped Razan get the shoes she wanted.
